mends.name: Restoration
mends.text: The priests pray over {hero}. The {wound} trouble them no more.

mends.name: Regrowth
mends.text: {healer} speaks the great prayer of regrowth over {hero}. Where the {wound} was, the flesh is whole.

mends.name: Clockwork
mends.text: The artificers fit {hero} with {part}. It whirs, clicks, and does its work.

wounds.name: lost eye
wounds.text: {hero} comes home from {site} with one eye. The other is somewhere in there.

wounds.name: lost hand
wounds.text: {hero} comes home from {site} short a hand, wrapped in a bloody shirt.

wounds.name: lame leg
wounds.text: {hero} limps home from {site}. The leg will never be what it was.

wounds.name: bad knee
wounds.text: {hero}'s knee went the wrong way at {site}. It clicks on every stair now.

wounds.name: burn scars
wounds.text: {hero} comes back from {site} burned down one side. Children stare.

wounds.name: cracked ribs
wounds.text: {hero} cracked their ribs at {site} and breathes in short gasps.
wounds.healed: {hero}'s ribs have knitted. They can laugh again without wincing.

wounds.name: ringing ears
wounds.text: Something went off beside {hero}'s head at {site}. They shout everything now.
wounds.healed: The ringing in {hero}'s ears has stopped.

wounds.name: shaking hands
wounds.text: {hero} came close to dying at {site}. Their hands have not stopped shaking.
